correctness.rationale: Convert box-slice Q_n to simplex truncated at each vertex, so all edges are either short v_pq−v_pr or long v_pq−v_qp. Short two-ray lattice indices have coprime minors −2,−3 and hence smooth cones. In a saturated plane basis long rays are (−(2n−1),2) and (1,2), determinant −4n, and fractional generator has ray coefficients (1,2n−1)/(4n), giving type 1/(4n)(1,2n−1). HJ negative fraction 4n/(2n−1)=[3,2^(n−2),3], canonical index 4n/gcd(4n,2n)=2, minimum nontrivial cyclic age 1/2. Toric orbit-cone correspondence exhausts codimension-two singular components and does not claim higher codimension. Independently recomputed saturated indices, quotient ages and HJ chains for n=3..9; all-n proof from lattice identities.
residual_risks: Finite n=3..9 minor enumerations are not an all-n proof; symbolic saturated-lattice basis and truncation argument are required.
